svg.title: ConvictionDesk architecture
svg.desc: Seven layers from market, SEC and portfolio sources through typed point-in-time evidence, a deterministic Decimal financial engine, attention and research orchestration, Fast or Deep decision, action plus thesis delta, to immutable decision records. Planned extensions are dashed.
